chunks: And from him, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim al-Bajalī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who menstruates in the month of Ramaḍān before the sun sets. He said: She breaks her fast when she menstruates.

key_terms.تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun sets; the time of sunset
key_terms.حِينَ: at the time when; immediately when
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the obligatory month of fasting

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman begins menstruation before sunset during a fast in Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who begins menstruation during a day of fasting in the month of Ramaḍān before sunset. The Imam عليه السلام states that her fast ends at the moment menstruation begins, establishing the ruling that menstruation nullifies the fast for that day.
